name: A Treat for a Friend
summary: Gobam asks you to bring a treat to Jezap Jinglesprocket in Bolder'ok. Jezap says keeping Snufflesnout happy, by which he means Chub'chob, matters most.

sections.title: Gobam's Request
sections.body: The bundle of goods Gobam hands you is a treat for Snufflesnout, Chub'chob's pet boar, and he says she will snort with happiness when she sees it. He also asks you to tell the goblin Jezap to talk less.

faq.answer: Gobam says the treat is for Snufflesnout, Chub'chob's pet boar.

faq.q: Who should I deliver the goods to?
faq.answer: The bundle of goods is for Jezap Jinglesprocket in Bolder'ok.

faq.q: What message should I pass along?
faq.answer: Gobam asks you to tell Jezap to stop talking so much.
Snufflesnout is Chub'chob's pet boar, which Jezap promised to look after. Jezap jokes that keeping Snufflesnout happy really means keeping Chub'chob happy.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Treat for a Friend
